preprocessing.spacing_selection: fixed a priori, no validation labels or image statistics
preprocessing.input_fov: entire resampled CT; no mask-derived image crop
preprocessing.auxiliary_use: training targets and training patch sampling only; never inference inputs
preprocessing.topology: 26-neighbour Lee skeleton; cluster junctions; BFS from maximum-radius branch per graph component
preprocessing.location_bins: 0 empty; 1..6 image-z tertile crossed with image-x half; geometric, not anatomy
preprocessing.gaussian: cumulative radius-aware sum, 4-sigma cube support, positive-volume maximum normalization
preprocessing.float_storage: image/gaussian/radius float16; labels/skeleton/depth uint8; branch_id uint16
